noah: quick note from miru-v1 onboarding (int8). We see elevated sampling entropy + sporadic CJK grapheme splits and occasional bracket mirroring in mixed RTL samples. Greedy is fine. Anyone seen an int8-only sampling instability pattern? :confused:
sora: paste the run args and a tiny example?
noah: ran on dedicated-staging, quant=int8, sampler=top-p=0.93,temp=0.85. Numbers:
```
# n=96 samples
en mean_entropy=3.0 token_split_rate=0.01
zh mean_entropy=5.2 token_split_rate=0.08
ko mean_entropy=5.0 token_split_rate=0.07
ar mean_entropy=4.1 token_split_rate=0.05
```
noah: example zh src: "\u8bf7\u5728\u4e0b\u9762\u8f93\u5165\u5168\u540d\u3002"
sample: "\u8bf7 \u5728 \u4e0b \u9762 \u8f93 \u5165 \u5168 \u540d\u3002"
ying: big gap between greedy and sampling suggests tail logits jitter. Did you compare float vs int8 logits for a problematic prefix?
noah: yes — float has clearer margin; int8 shows many subtokens bunched near-equal mass. gist with per-step logits: https://gist.github.com/redwood/miru-int8-logits (redacted).
sora: check detok path. We recently unrolled "fast-detok-swap" on the int8 build. If sampling uses a different detok or fast-byte preproc, that could explain space insertions.
devops-bot: deploy note: fast-detok-swap rolled 5 days ago (deploy/2026-03-20-fast-detok).
ying: also consider fused-softmax-int8 micro-optim that was merged last week. If softmax numerical range collapses, sampling picks unstable tail tokens. Can you run a small kernel-matrix: (float-runtime/int8-weights, int8-runtime/int8-weights, int8-runtime/float-weights)?
noah: queuing a 3x run with n=64 per locale. Command: `./scripts/onboard_sampling.sh --model miru-v1 --quant int8 --locales zh,ko,en,ar --sampler top-p=0.93,temp=0.85 --n 64 --out miru-int8-matrix.json`
sora: add `--detok=utf8-normalize` vs `--detok=fast-byte` variants. If detok narrows it, we have a preprocessing path bug.
ying: short-term mitigation: for miru-v1 int8 onboarding set recommended sampler to top-p=0.85,temp=0.6 for zh/ko and add a note in the onboarding doc. Also add a unit check: sample_entropy_delta between quant and float <= 0.7 or fail onboarding.
eval-bot: CI run ci-7259 started (miru int8 sampling-matrix). link: https://ci.internal/runs/ci-7259 :rocket:
noah: filed ML-1607 with examples + logs. Assign @sora to validate detok flags, @ying to run kernel matrix and bisect fused-softmax commits, @noah to collate prompt set and add gating test. Update in ~3h. :thumbsup:
